+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = pivotDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = pivotDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                    pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = candidate;
+                    pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(first + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = pathValues[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Resolve every tile in the pivot row and column. The target tile is kept as
+// an immutable shared-memory snapshot while each output element performs its
+// 32-way min-plus reduction. The already closed pivot tile represents any
+// number of paths internal to this pivot block.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(TILE_SIZE * BLOCK_ROWS)
+void resolvePivotRowAndColumn(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                              unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                              const size_t distPitch,
+                              const size_t pathPitch,
+                              const size_t numNodes,
+                              const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE];
+    __shared__ unsigned int targetDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedTile = blockIdx.x;
+    const int targetTile = packedTile + (packedTile >= pivot);
+    const int targetFirst = targetTile * TILE_SIZE;
+    const bool isPivotRow = blockIdx.y == 0;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+        const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+        const size_t pivotRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + y);
+        const size_t pivotCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + x);
+        pivotDist[y][x] = (pivotRow < numNodes && pivotCol < numNodes)
+                              ? dist[pivotRow * distPitch + pivotCol]
+                              : INF;
+
+        const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>((isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + y);
+        const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>((isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + x);
+        targetDist[y][x] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                               ? dist[row * distPitch + col]
+                               : INF;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int best[TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS];
+    unsigned int bestPath[TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+        const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+        const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>((isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + y);
+        const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>((isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + x);
+        best[lane] = targetDist[y][x];
+        bestPath[lane] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                             ? path[row * pathPitch + col]
+                             : 0;
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        // This operand is common to all four rows owned by the thread. Keeping
+        // k as the outer loop cuts shared-memory traffic nearly in half.
+        const unsigned int common = isPivotRow ? targetDist[k][x] : pivotDist[k][x];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+            const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+            const unsigned int candidate =
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotDist[y][k] : targetDist[y][k]) + common;
+            if (candidate < best[lane]) {
+                best[lane] = candidate;
+                bestPath[lane] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+        const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+        const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>((isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + y);
+        const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>((isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + x);
+        if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes && best[lane] < targetDist[y][x]) {
+            dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[lane];
+            path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[lane];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Update all tiles outside the pivot row and column. Each block loads the two
+// input tiles once and computes four outputs per thread entirely in registers.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(TILE_SIZE * BLOCK_ROWS)
+void resolveRemainingTiles(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                           unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                           const size_t distPitch,
+                           const size_t pathPitch,
+                           const size_t numNodes,
+                           const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int columnDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE];
+    __shared__ unsigned int rowDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedColumn = blockIdx.x;
+    const int packedRow = blockIdx.y;
+    const int outputTileColumn = packedColumn + (packedColumn >= pivot);
+    const int outputTileRow = packedRow + (packedRow >= pivot);
+    const int outputFirstColumn = outputTileColumn * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int outputFirstRow = outputTileRow * TILE_SIZE;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+        const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+        const size_t columnRow = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + y);
+        const size_t columnCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + x);
+        columnDist[y][x] = (columnRow < numNodes && columnCol < numNodes)
+                               ? dist[columnRow * distPitch + columnCol]
+                               : INF;
+
+        const size_t rowRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + y);
+        const size_t rowCol = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + x);
+        rowDist[y][x] = (rowRow < numNodes && rowCol < numNodes)
+                            ? dist[rowRow * distPitch + rowCol]
+                            : INF;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int original[TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS];
+    unsigned int best[TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS];
+    unsigned int bestPath[TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+        const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+        const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + y);
+        const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + x);
+        if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+            original[lane] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+            bestPath[lane] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+        } else {
+            original[lane] = INF;
+            bestPath[lane] = 0;
+        }
+        best[lane] = original[lane];
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        const unsigned int common = rowDist[k][x];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+            const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+            const unsigned int candidate = columnDist[y][k] + common;
+            if (candidate < best[lane]) {
+                best[lane] = candidate;
+                bestPath[lane] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+        const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+        const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + y);
+        const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + x);
+        if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes && best[lane] < original[lane]) {
+            dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[lane];
+            path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[lane];
+        }
+    }
+}
+

+// Resolve the pivot tile. A 32x8 thread block owns four rows per thread; the
+// whole distance tile remains in shared memory across all 32 pivot steps.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotTile(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                      unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                      const size_t distPitch,
+                      const size_t pathPitch,
+                      const size_t numNodes,
+                      const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int first = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    unsigned int pathValues[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = INF;
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }

+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {

+// Resolve the pivot tile. A 32x8 thread block owns four rows per thread; the
+// whole distance tile remains in shared memory across all 32 pivot steps.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotTile(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                      unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                      const size_t distPitch,
+                      const size_t pathPitch,
+                      const size_t numNodes,
+                      const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int first = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    unsigned int pathValues[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = INF;
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int validPivots = min(TILE_SIZE, static_cast<int>(numNodes) - first);
+    for (int k = 0; k < validPivots; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = pivotDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = pivotDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                    pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = candidate;
+                    pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(first + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = pathValues[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }

+void resolvePivotRowAndColumn(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,

+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {

+            const int tileCol = x + part * BLOCK_DIM;

+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

+inline void checkCuda(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+        cudaFailure(error, operation);
+    }

+// Resolve the pivot tile. A 32x8 thread block owns four rows per thread; the
+// whole distance tile remains in shared memory across all 32 pivot steps.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotTile(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                      unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                      const size_t distPitch,
+                      const size_t pathPitch,
+                      const size_t numNodes,
+                      const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int first = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    unsigned int pathValues[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = INF;
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int validPivots = min(TILE_SIZE, static_cast<int>(numNodes) - first);
+    for (int k = 0; k < validPivots; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = pivotDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = pivotDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                    pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = candidate;
+                    pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(first + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = pathValues[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Resolve every tile in the pivot row and column. The target tile is kept as
+// an immutable shared-memory snapshot while each output element performs its
+// 32-way min-plus reduction. The already closed pivot tile represents any
+// number of paths internal to this pivot block.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotRowAndColumn(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                              unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                              const size_t distPitch,
+                              const size_t pathPitch,
+                              const size_t numNodes,
+                              const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int targetDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedTile = blockIdx.x;
+    const int targetTile = packedTile + (packedTile >= pivot);
+    const int targetFirst = targetTile * TILE_SIZE;
+    const bool isPivotRow = blockIdx.y == 0;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t pivotRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileRow);
+            const size_t pivotCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileCol);
+            pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (pivotRow < numNodes && pivotCol < numNodes)
+                                                  ? dist[pivotRow * distPitch + pivotCol]
+                                                  : INF;
+
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            targetDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                    ? dist[row * distPitch + col]
+                                                    : INF;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int best[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int bestPath[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            best[rowPart][colPart] = targetDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+            bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                   ? path[row * pathPitch + col]
+                                                   : 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            const int tileRow = y + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            fromRow[part] = isPivotRow ? pivotDist[tileRow][k]
+                                            : targetDist[tileRow][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = isPivotRow ? targetDist[k][tileCol]
+                                               : pivotDist[k][tileCol];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes &&
+                best[rowPart][colPart] < targetDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[rowPart][colPart];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Update all tiles outside the pivot row and column. Each block loads the two
+// input tiles once and computes four outputs per thread entirely in registers.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(TILE_SIZE * BLOCK_ROWS)
+void resolveRemainingTiles(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                           unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                           const size_t distPitch,
+                           const size_t pathPitch,
+                           const size_t numNodes,
+                           const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int columnDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE];
+    __shared__ unsigned int rowDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedColumn = blockIdx.x;
+    const int packedRow = blockIdx.y;
+    const int outputTileColumn = packedColumn + (packedColumn >= pivot);
+    const int outputTileRow = packedRow + (packedRow >= pivot);
+    const int outputFirstColumn = outputTileColumn * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int outputFirstRow = outputTileRow * TILE_SIZE;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+        const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+        const size_t columnRow = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + y);
+        const size_t columnCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + x);
+        columnDist[y][x] = (columnRow < numNodes && columnCol < numNodes)
+                               ? dist[columnRow * distPitch + columnCol]
+                               : INF;
+
+        const size_t rowRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + y);
+        const size_t rowCol = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + x);
+        rowDist[y][x] = (rowRow < numNodes && rowCol < numNodes)
+                            ? dist[rowRow * distPitch + rowCol]
+                            : INF;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int original[TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS];
+    unsigned int best[TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS];
+    unsigned int bestPath[TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+        const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+        const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + y);
+        const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + x);
+        if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+            original[lane] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+            bestPath[lane] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+        } else {
+            original[lane] = INF;
+            bestPath[lane] = 0;
+        }
+        best[lane] = original[lane];
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        const unsigned int common = rowDist[k][x];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+            const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+            const unsigned int candidate = columnDist[y][k] + common;
+            if (candidate < best[lane]) {
+                best[lane] = candidate;
+                bestPath[lane] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int lane = 0; lane < TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_ROWS; ++lane) {
+        const int y = threadIdx.y + lane * BLOCK_ROWS;
+        const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + y);
+        const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + x);
+        if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes && best[lane] < original[lane]) {
+            dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[lane];
+            path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[lane];
+        }
+    }
+}
+

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {

+// Resolve the pivot tile. A 32x8 thread block owns four rows per thread; the
+// whole distance tile remains in shared memory across all 32 pivot steps.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotTile(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                      unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                      const size_t distPitch,
+                      const size_t pathPitch,
+                      const size_t numNodes,
+                      const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int first = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    unsigned int pathValues[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = INF;
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int validPivots = min(TILE_SIZE, static_cast<int>(numNodes) - first);
+    for (int k = 0; k < validPivots; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = pivotDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = pivotDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                    pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = candidate;
+                    pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(first + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = pathValues[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Resolve every tile in the pivot row and column. The target tile is kept as
+// an immutable shared-memory snapshot while each output element performs its
+// 32-way min-plus reduction. The already closed pivot tile represents any
+// number of paths internal to this pivot block.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotRowAndColumn(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                              unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                              const size_t distPitch,
+                              const size_t pathPitch,
+                              const size_t numNodes,
+                              const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int targetDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedTile = blockIdx.x;
+    const int targetTile = packedTile + (packedTile >= pivot);
+    const int targetFirst = targetTile * TILE_SIZE;
+    const bool isPivotRow = blockIdx.y == 0;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t pivotRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileRow);
+            const size_t pivotCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileCol);
+            pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (pivotRow < numNodes && pivotCol < numNodes)
+                                                  ? dist[pivotRow * distPitch + pivotCol]
+                                                  : INF;
+
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            targetDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                    ? dist[row * distPitch + col]
+                                                    : INF;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int best[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int bestPath[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            best[rowPart][colPart] = targetDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+            bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                   ? path[row * pathPitch + col]
+                                                   : 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            const int tileRow = y + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            fromRow[part] = isPivotRow ? pivotDist[tileRow][k]
+                                            : targetDist[tileRow][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = isPivotRow ? targetDist[k][tileCol]
+                                               : pivotDist[k][tileCol];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes &&
+                best[rowPart][colPart] < targetDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[rowPart][colPart];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Update all tiles outside the pivot row and column. Each block loads the two
+// input tiles once and computes four outputs per thread entirely in registers.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolveRemainingTiles(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                           unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                           const size_t distPitch,
+                           const size_t pathPitch,
+                           const size_t numNodes,
+                           const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int columnDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int rowDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;

+    const int packedColumn = blockIdx.x;
+    const int packedRow = blockIdx.y;
+    const int outputTileColumn = packedColumn + (packedColumn >= pivot);
+    const int outputTileRow = packedRow + (packedRow >= pivot);
+    const int outputFirstColumn = outputTileColumn * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int outputFirstRow = outputTileRow * TILE_SIZE;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t columnRow = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t columnCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileCol);
+            columnDist[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (columnRow < numNodes && columnCol < numNodes)
+                    ? dist[columnRow * distPitch + columnCol]
+                    : INF;
+
+            const size_t rowRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileRow);
+            const size_t rowCol = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            rowDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (rowRow < numNodes && rowCol < numNodes)
+                                                 ? dist[rowRow * distPitch + rowCol]
+                                                 : INF;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int original[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int best[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int bestPath[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                original[rowPart][colPart] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                original[rowPart][colPart] = INF;
+                bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+            best[rowPart][colPart] = original[rowPart][colPart];
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = columnDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = rowDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;

+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);

+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[rowPart][colPart];

+constexpr int TILE_SIZE = 32;
+constexpr int BLOCK_DIM = 16;
+constexpr int OUTPUTS_PER_DIM = TILE_SIZE / BLOCK_DIM;
 
 // Index calculation for flattened 2D array
 inline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error during %s: %s\n", operation, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+inline void checkCuda(const cudaError_t error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+        cudaFailure(error, operation);
+    }
+}

+// Resolve the pivot tile. A 32x8 thread block owns four rows per thread; the
+// whole distance tile remains in shared memory across all 32 pivot steps.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotTile(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                      unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                      const size_t distPitch,
+                      const size_t pathPitch,
+                      const size_t numNodes,
+                      const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int first = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    unsigned int pathValues[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = INF;
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int validPivots = min(TILE_SIZE, static_cast<int>(numNodes) - first);
+    for (int k = 0; k < validPivots; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = pivotDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = pivotDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                    pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = candidate;
+                    pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(first + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = pathValues[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Resolve every tile in the pivot row and column. The target tile is kept as
+// an immutable shared-memory snapshot while each output element performs its
+// 32-way min-plus reduction. The already closed pivot tile represents any
+// number of paths internal to this pivot block.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotRowAndColumn(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                              unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                              const size_t distPitch,
+                              const size_t pathPitch,
+                              const size_t numNodes,
+                              const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int targetDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedTile = blockIdx.x;
+    const int targetTile = packedTile + (packedTile >= pivot);
+    const int targetFirst = targetTile * TILE_SIZE;
+    const bool isPivotRow = blockIdx.y == 0;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t pivotRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileRow);
+            const size_t pivotCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileCol);
+            pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (pivotRow < numNodes && pivotCol < numNodes)
+                                                  ? dist[pivotRow * distPitch + pivotCol]
+                                                  : INF;
+
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            targetDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                    ? dist[row * distPitch + col]
+                                                    : INF;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int best[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int bestPath[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            best[rowPart][colPart] = targetDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+            bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                   ? path[row * pathPitch + col]
+                                                   : 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            const int tileRow = y + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            fromRow[part] = isPivotRow ? pivotDist[tileRow][k]
+                                            : targetDist[tileRow][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = isPivotRow ? targetDist[k][tileCol]
+                                               : pivotDist[k][tileCol];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes &&
+                best[rowPart][colPart] < targetDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[rowPart][colPart];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Update all tiles outside the pivot row and column. Each block loads the two
+// input tiles once and computes four outputs per thread entirely in registers.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolveRemainingTiles(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                           unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                           const size_t distPitch,
+                           const size_t pathPitch,
+                           const size_t numNodes,
+                           const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int columnDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int rowDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedColumn = blockIdx.x;
+    const int packedRow = blockIdx.y;
+    const int outputTileColumn = packedColumn + (packedColumn >= pivot);
+    const int outputTileRow = packedRow + (packedRow >= pivot);
+    const int outputFirstColumn = outputTileColumn * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int outputFirstRow = outputTileRow * TILE_SIZE;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t columnRow = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t columnCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileCol);
+            columnDist[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (columnRow < numNodes && columnCol < numNodes)
+                    ? dist[columnRow * distPitch + columnCol]
+                    : INF;
+
+            const size_t rowRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileRow);
+            const size_t rowCol = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            rowDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (rowRow < numNodes && rowCol < numNodes)
+                                                 ? dist[rowRow * distPitch + rowCol]
+                                                 : INF;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int original[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int best[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int bestPath[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                original[rowPart][colPart] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                original[rowPart][colPart] = INF;
+                bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+            best[rowPart][colPart] = original[rowPart][colPart];
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = columnDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = rowDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes &&
+                best[rowPart][colPart] < original[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[rowPart][colPart];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = INF;
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int validPivots = min(TILE_SIZE, static_cast<int>(numNodes) - first);
+    for (int k = 0; k < validPivots; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = pivotDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = pivotDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                    pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = candidate;
+                    pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(first + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = pathValues[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Resolve every tile in the pivot row and column. The target tile is kept as
+// an immutable shared-memory snapshot while each output element performs its
+// 32-way min-plus reduction. The already closed pivot tile represents any
+// number of paths internal to this pivot block.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotRowAndColumn(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                              unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                              const size_t distPitch,
+                              const size_t pathPitch,
+                              const size_t numNodes,
+                              const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int targetDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedTile = blockIdx.x;
+    const int targetTile = packedTile + (packedTile >= pivot);
+    const int targetFirst = targetTile * TILE_SIZE;
+    const bool isPivotRow = blockIdx.y == 0;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t pivotRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileRow);
+            const size_t pivotCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileCol);
+            pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (pivotRow < numNodes && pivotCol < numNodes)
+                                                  ? dist[pivotRow * distPitch + pivotCol]
+                                                  : INF;
+
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            targetDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                    ? dist[row * distPitch + col]
+                                                    : INF;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int best[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int bestPath[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            best[rowPart][colPart] = targetDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+            bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                   ? path[row * pathPitch + col]
+                                                   : 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            const int tileRow = y + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            fromRow[part] = isPivotRow ? pivotDist[tileRow][k]
+                                            : targetDist[tileRow][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = isPivotRow ? targetDist[k][tileCol]
+                                               : pivotDist[k][tileCol];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes &&
+                best[rowPart][colPart] < targetDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[rowPart][colPart];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Update all tiles outside the pivot row and column. Each block loads the two
+// input tiles once and computes four outputs per thread entirely in registers.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolveRemainingTiles(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                           unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                           const size_t distPitch,
+                           const size_t pathPitch,
+                           const size_t numNodes,
+                           const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int columnDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int rowDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedColumn = blockIdx.x;
+    const int packedRow = blockIdx.y;
+    const int outputTileColumn = packedColumn + (packedColumn >= pivot);
+    const int outputTileRow = packedRow + (packedRow >= pivot);
+    const int outputFirstColumn = outputTileColumn * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int outputFirstRow = outputTileRow * TILE_SIZE;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t columnRow = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t columnCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileCol);
+            columnDist[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (columnRow < numNodes && columnCol < numNodes)
+                    ? dist[columnRow * distPitch + columnCol]
+                    : INF;
+
+            const size_t rowRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileRow);
+            const size_t rowCol = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            rowDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (rowRow < numNodes && rowCol < numNodes)
+                                                 ? dist[rowRow * distPitch + rowCol]
+                                                 : INF;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int original[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int best[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int bestPath[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                original[rowPart][colPart] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                original[rowPart][colPart] = INF;
+                bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+            best[rowPart][colPart] = original[rowPart][colPart];
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = columnDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = rowDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes &&
+                best[rowPart][colPart] < original[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[rowPart][colPart];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// thread; the whole distance tile remains shared across all 32 pivot steps.

+// Resolve every tile in the pivot row and column. The target tile is kept as
+// an immutable shared-memory snapshot while each output element performs its
+// 32-way min-plus reduction. The already closed pivot tile represents any
+// number of paths internal to this pivot block.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotRowAndColumn(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                              unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                              const size_t distPitch,
+                              const size_t pathPitch,
+                              const size_t numNodes,
+                              const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int targetDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedTile = blockIdx.x;
+    const int targetTile = packedTile + (packedTile >= pivot);
+    const int targetFirst = targetTile * TILE_SIZE;
+    const bool isPivotRow = blockIdx.y == 0;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t pivotRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileRow);
+            const size_t pivotCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileCol);
+            pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (pivotRow < numNodes && pivotCol < numNodes)
+                                                  ? dist[pivotRow * distPitch + pivotCol]
+                                                  : INF;
+
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            targetDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                    ? dist[row * distPitch + col]
+                                                    : INF;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int best[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int bestPath[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            best[rowPart][colPart] = targetDist[tileRow][tileCol];
+            bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = (row < numNodes && col < numNodes)
+                                                   ? path[row * pathPitch + col]
+                                                   : 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            const int tileRow = y + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + part * BLOCK_DIM;
+            fromRow[part] = isPivotRow ? pivotDist[tileRow][k]
+                                            : targetDist[tileRow][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = isPivotRow ? targetDist[k][tileCol]
+                                               : pivotDist[k][tileCol];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? pivotFirst : targetFirst) + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(
+                (isPivotRow ? targetFirst : pivotFirst) + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes &&
+                best[rowPart][colPart] < targetDist[tileRow][tileCol]) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[rowPart][colPart];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// Update all tiles outside the pivot row and column. Each block loads the two
+// input tiles once and computes four outputs per thread entirely in registers.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolveRemainingTiles(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                           unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                           const size_t distPitch,
+                           const size_t pathPitch,
+                           const size_t numNodes,
+                           const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int columnDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+    __shared__ unsigned int rowDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int pivotFirst = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int packedColumn = blockIdx.x;
+    const int packedRow = blockIdx.y;
+    const int outputTileColumn = packedColumn + (packedColumn >= pivot);
+    const int outputTileRow = packedRow + (packedRow >= pivot);
+    const int outputFirstColumn = outputTileColumn * TILE_SIZE;
+    const int outputFirstRow = outputTileRow * TILE_SIZE;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t columnRow = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t columnCol = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileCol);
+            columnDist[tileRow][tileCol] =
+                (columnRow < numNodes && columnCol < numNodes)
+                    ? dist[columnRow * distPitch + columnCol]
+                    : INF;
+
+            const size_t rowRow = static_cast<size_t>(pivotFirst + tileRow);
+            const size_t rowCol = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            rowDist[tileRow][tileCol] = (rowRow < numNodes && rowCol < numNodes)
+                                                 ? dist[rowRow * distPitch + rowCol]
+                                                 : INF;
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    unsigned int original[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int best[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+    unsigned int bestPath[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                original[rowPart][colPart] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                original[rowPart][colPart] = INF;
+                bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+            best[rowPart][colPart] = original[rowPart][colPart];
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int k = 0; k < TILE_SIZE; ++k) {
+        unsigned int fromRow[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = columnDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = rowDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
+        }
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+            for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+                const unsigned int candidate = fromRow[rowPart] + fromColumn[colPart];
+                if (candidate < best[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                    best[rowPart][colPart] = candidate;
+                    bestPath[rowPart][colPart] = static_cast<unsigned int>(pivotFirst + k);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstRow + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(outputFirstColumn + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes &&
+                best[rowPart][colPart] < original[rowPart][colPart]) {
+                dist[row * distPitch + col] = best[rowPart][colPart];
+                path[row * pathPitch + col] = bestPath[rowPart][colPart];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Resolve the pivot tile. A 16x16 thread block owns a 2x2 group of outputs per
+// thread; the whole distance tile remains shared across all 32 pivot steps.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM)
+void resolvePivotTile(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,
+                      unsigned int* __restrict__ path,
+                      const size_t distPitch,
+                      const size_t pathPitch,
+                      const size_t numNodes,
+                      const int pivot) {
+    __shared__ unsigned int pivotDist[TILE_SIZE][TILE_SIZE + 1];
+
+    const int x = threadIdx.x;
+    const int y = threadIdx.y;
+    const int first = pivot * TILE_SIZE;
+    unsigned int pathValues[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM][OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rowPart = 0; rowPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++rowPart) {
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int colPart = 0; colPart < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++colPart) {
+            const int tileRow = y + rowPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const int tileCol = x + colPart * BLOCK_DIM;
+            const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileRow);
+            const size_t col = static_cast<size_t>(first + tileCol);
+            if (row < numNodes && col < numNodes) {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = dist[row * distPitch + col];
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = path[row * pathPitch + col];
+            } else {
+                pivotDist[tileRow][tileCol] = INF;
+                pathValues[rowPart][colPart] = 0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    __syncthreads();

+    for (int k = 0; k < validPivots; ++k) {

+        unsigned int fromColumn[OUTPUTS_PER_DIM];
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int part = 0; part < OUTPUTS_PER_DIM; ++part) {
+            fromRow[part] = pivotDist[y + part * BLOCK_DIM][k];
+            fromColumn[part] = pivotDist[k][x + part * BLOCK_DIM];
